$comment: Every model id the room uses, as <provider>/<model>. Role prompts carry {{placeholders}} the plugin fills from this file when a seat is created, so a model change needs no prompt edit. Every provider named here must be enabled in paseo/seats.yml (install.sh checks). Add pi-* or opencode-* providers here after enabling those seats.

cheap.use: mechanical, fully specified: extraction, renames, formatting, log triage, doc edits, test scaffolds

default.use: implementation, debugging, multi-file changes with invariants, research with judgement

expensive.use: architecture decisions, cross-module invariants, subtle concurrency or data bugs, a task that failed at default

cross-family.use: the reviewer of a Claude-written candidate, a tie-break, a retry after a Claude Peer failed

lens.$comment: Lenses are not Peers: strong models that think independently for the Lead, from a neutral brief, without the Lead's judgement or context. One lens = the oracle. Two = the pair, which must be two different models. More = add from pool, never the same model twice.
